questions.q: The management team decided ______ the office renovation until next spring.
questions.exp: 空格前是 decide，decide 後面接動詞時用 to＋原形：decided to postpone。postpone 自己後面才接 -ing。

questions.q: We are considering ______ our customer service hours on weekends.
questions.exp: consider 後面接 -ing，不說 consider to do。

questions.q: Please remember ______ the signed form to Human Resources before Friday.
questions.exp: before Friday 是還沒做的事，提醒「別忘了去做」用 remember to；remember＋-ing 是回想做過的事。

questions.q: The supervisor made the new staff ______ the safety manual before starting work.
questions.exp: make 是使役動詞，主動句裡接「人＋原形」：made the new staff read。改成被動才加 to（were made to read）。

questions.q: We look forward to ______ with your company again next year.
questions.exp: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞（可以接名詞：look forward to the meeting），後面的動詞用 -ing。

questions.q: The manager asked the team ______ the proposal by Monday.
questions.exp: ask＋人＋to＋原形：asked the team to revise。不加 to 的是 make、let、have 這幾個使役動詞。

questions.q: Mr. Wu ______ in the accounting department, but he moved to sales last year.
questions.exp: 「以前在會計部，現在不是了」用 used to＋原形 work，前面不加 be。be used to 是「習慣」，後面接 -ing 不接原形；used to working 少了 be 動詞；uses to 不是正確形式。

questions.q: The training room was too small ______ all the participants.
questions.exp: too＋形容詞＋to＋原形：too small to hold（太小，容納不下）。

questions.q: 哪一句的意思是「我們不再印紙本發票了」？
opts: We stopped to print paper invoices.
We didn't stop to print paper invoices.
We remembered to print paper invoices.
questions.exp: stop＋-ing 是不再做原本在做的事；stop＋to 是停下手邊的事、為了去做另一件事。

questions.q: The new expense software helps employees ______ their receipts more easily.
questions.exp: help＋人＋（to）原形，不接 -ing：helps employees track。help someone doing 是錯的。
